classes.lede: Two-door cars, from the ’85 Futo and Blista to the Windsor Drop.
American muscle from the ’50 Albany Hermes to the Gauntlet Hellfire, with four kinds of Vapid Dominator.
Buggies and other off-roaders, from the ’73 BF Injection to the HVY Wastelander.
Pickup trucks, with four versions of the Bravado Bison alone.
The biggest class in the game.
Fast two-seaters. The Banshee, Growler and Coquette D10 are also on [Randy’s wish list](/guides/side-contacts/#randy-list).

Nine supercars, from the ’95 Grotti Cheetah to the Granforma Zorrusso. They drive around at random; six of them (Furia, Infernus, Itali RSX, Tempesta, Vitello and Zorrusso) are also on [Randy’s wish list](/guides/side-contacts/#randy-list).
SUVs and 4x4s, from the Gallivanter Baller to two versions each of the Declasse Granger and the Vapid Montagne. They turn up at random in traffic.
Motorbikes, plus bicycles such as the Tuff BMX.
Boats of every size, from the Crest Kayak and three Seasharks to the Airgator Airboat 09. They turn up at random; the Vice City harbor is the best place to start.
Planes and helicopters. Helicopters sit on Vice City rooftops marked with an H on the map; planes wait at airstrips and Vice City International Airport.
Lorries and rigs. Service vehicles turn up at building sites and in industrial areas.
Small work vehicles, from the Airtug to the Telehandler.
The Ambulance, the Police Riot and the rest of the emergency fleet.
Parked at Mile Zero Air Station, the base south of Key Lento, or sent after you at a high wanted level.
Heavy machines such as the Bulldozer and the Excavator, found at building sites and in industrial areas.
Buses, the Seacab and the Taxi.

faq.q: How many vehicles are in GTA 6?
faq.a: 557 at launch, counting the Ultimate Edition's extras. They split into 277 **base models**, the ordinary versions you see on the road, and 280 **Standout vehicles**, one-off builds in 25 styles that sit at fixed spots or come as rewards.

faq.q: How many vehicles do you need for 100% in GTA 6?
faq.a: Any 200 of the 277 base models. Standout vehicles don't count toward 100% or any trophy. **Whip It Good** asks for 100 discovered vehicles, so you get it halfway there.

faq.q: How do you discover a vehicle in GTA 6?
faq.a: Either drive it once or scan it with WAiNK: hold **D-pad Up** to open the scanner, aim at the vehicle and press **R1 / RB**. Scanning is quicker, and it works on parked and passing traffic, boats and aircraft. Your count is in the pause menu under **Progress › Vehicles**, in the same order as the lists on this page.

faq.q: Where do you find planes, helicopters and boats in GTA 6?
faq.a: Helicopters sit on Vice City rooftops marked with an **H** on the map. Planes wait at airstrips and at Vice City International Airport. For boats and jet skis, go to the Vice City harbor. Military vehicles are at **Mile Zero Air Station** south of Key Lento, or come to you once your wanted level is high enough.

faq.q: How many boats are in GTA 6?
faq.a: 28 watercraft count as base models, from the Crest Kayak and the Airgator Airboat 09 to six Calder models and three Seasharks. They count under **Progress › Vehicles › Watercraft**, and scanning one with WAiNK is enough to discover it, so you never have to get on board.

faq.q: Do Standout vehicles count for anything?
faq.a: Not for 100% or trophies. They're one-offs in 25 styles, from Lowriders and Donks to Swamp Style, that sit at fixed spots or come as rewards, so collect the ones you like.
